name: Streaming Iii The Hedge Fund Industry Structure Size And Performance Ea211Da608
text: The Hedge Fund Industry: Structure, Size, and Performance states that hedge funds are often organized as private partnerships and resident offshore for tax and regulatory purposes. This supports the offshore-center premise underlying Kaal's claim that legislators faced incentives to avoid requirements that could drive hedge-fund business offshore. The abstract does not establish that any particular regulatory increase caused relocation or quantify the franchise-tax effect.
